purpose: Evidence-bound audit before final release and lifecycle closure.

claims.claim: WI-01 through WI-17 have archived Contract, Summary, and Outcome records in the canonical archive index.
WI-01 through WI-15 archived Outcomes do not contain the WI-16 humanHandoff projection; WI-16 and WI-17 do contain it.

The archive records no causal performance improvement across environments; WI-15 records a bounded same-environment comparison of 550.85 seconds versus 343.22 seconds, approximately 37.7% lower wall time.
A recorded parallel run observed approximately 11 minutes for three concurrent strict finishes versus approximately 10 minutes for the comparable serial run.

The current local release-readiness gate passed for candidate v0.5.61, while provider publication evidence remains pending until the exact merged main commit is dispatched through the release workflow.
The stale remote branch codex/wi-08-content-bound-reuse was superseded by merged PR #855 and was deleted after identity review.
After audited cleanup, no codex/* remote branch remains; local recovery branch backup/wi08-pre-base-reconcile and the dirty pre-release branch remain intentionally retained.

Seven linked worktrees remain: the active WI-18 worktree, the dirty root worktree, the dirty pre-release worktree, and four dirty temporary WI-16 governance worktrees; clean superseded Work Item worktrees were removed.
